Extracts information on MPhil in Ethics of AI, Data and Algorithms: full-time, 9-month, research degree, eligible for dependent visa as it meets all UK immigration requirements.
Extracts information on MPhil in History and Philosophy of Science and Medicine: full-time, 9-month, research degree, eligible for dependent visa, assessed by research essays and dissertation.

User requests concise information on mainstream and branches of doctorate degrees.
System provides a summary: mainstream is PhD/DPhil, branches include professional doctorates like EdD, DBA, EngD, JSD/SJD, MD, DMin, DArch.
User asks about degrees offered by Chinese universities compared to the UK system.
System explains China's three-level, two-type degree system: bachelor's, master's, doctorate, each divided into academic and professional degrees, with comparisons to the UK system.
